item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Network Watcher – AI summary of connection troubleshoot results
item.description:
Azure Network Watcher now has a public preview feature that uses AI to summarize connection troubleshoot results. It is intended to make the output of the four diagnostic connectivity tests easier and faster to understand.

  • Source: Azure Updates
